dedupe_keys.name: mria multiregional impact assessment model for disaster analysis mria py

description: A multiregional input-output model for the economic effects of disasters. The GitHub repository offers mria_py, a Python implementation to use with input-output and supply-use data, under the MIT licence, requiring NumPy, Pyomo, IPOPT, pandas and geopandas, based on Koks and Thissen (2016) in Economic Systems Research. The updated model on arXiv (August 2025, Vanniya Perumal, Thissen, de Ruiter and Koks) captures regional post-disaster trade and logistics limits, finds that more production capacity alone is not enough without trade flexibility, and adds a sectoral criticality assessment. The code is a free download. Coverage is any set of regions with input-output data. Caveats: users must supply regional tables and a solver. For simulation it estimates regional and national output losses when a disaster cuts production or transport links. A related catalogue record is the Inoue production network simulator.
